LABELS (K1).
- Every signal taken alone with FP costs, in both cost modes (labels_mode 'fp').
- Thresholds are fitted on that FP table: signals decided before 1 January Y minus 7 days; usable = filled, not refused, not still open at the frame end; terciles, q = 1/3; the worse side is skipped only if min(E_lo, E_hi) < 0; at least 100 training signals; history from 31 January of Y-1.
- In the x1.5 run the skip is applied with each signal's own x1.5 riskbp, and the chain's 3-spread refusals are those of x1.5.
- T(2022) = 478.284 bp is binding: the 2022 fold must be within 0.01 bp of it (478.28 is within), else the run stops before any result is written.
- T(2023), T(2024) and T(2025) are refitted on each 1 January.

LIVE SEMANTICS ('as the live program would').
- Every lab-filled order is entered one minute late at market: the open of the bar after its lab fill bar, ask/bid x (1 +/- market slippage).
- An absolute stop stays at its price; a stop distance stays a distance from the new fill. Time exits, trailing and break-even are unchanged.
- One position per sleeve, 'entry_bar' (the synthesis_B verifiers' 'run as the current hands would'): the chain is re-simulated with the live exits and the one-position test is made at the delayed entry bar.
- Every open position is closed at market at the open of the first bar at or after Friday 16:50 New York (InpFridayClose 23:50 server) of the first Friday on or after its entry's New-York date. A us100 position still open on Friday 16:50 New York (us100 already shut, about 16:15) is closed at the next reopen.
- No new position when the decision instant (the close of the lab fill bar) OR the delayed entry bar falls at or after Friday 16:50 and before Sunday 17:00 New York ('live_friday_block' = 'decision_and_entry').
- The broker's 3-spread refusal is applied at the live fill bar with that bar's open spread; a refused order never blocks the sleeve.
- The K1 skip is decided as in lab.

SCALING. Equal weekly swing: k = weekly sd of the reference / weekly sd of the variant, both measured on the judged window 2022-01-01 .. 2025-12-31, in the row's cost mode, execution and account. The factor is recomputed on the window, not fixed in sample.

ACCOUNT.
- The criteria are judged on the plain sum: every trade of every sleeve's own one-position chain at 1 R, no position cap, no compounding (synthesis_B's portfolio metrics).
- Reported beside it, not judged: the capped account. At most 6 positions and 2 per market, trades offered in entry order with ties in ASCII order of '<rule>_<sym>'. A position blocks a new entry until its exit time is strictly before that entry. Run over the whole frame, judged on the window.

WEEKS.
- Server weeks Monday to Sunday, server time = New York + 7 h; a trade is booked in the week of its exit.
- The series runs from the week of 2022-01-01 to the week of 2025-12-31 23:59, every week counted (a week with no exit is 0). The first week (27 Dec 2021 - 2 Jan 2022) is therefore 0.
- sd uses ddof 1; weekly Sharpe = mean / sd x sqrt(52).
- By year: trades entered in the year, over the weeks whose Thursday falls in it; the window's first and last weeks are clipped into 2022 and 2025.

COSTS AND CONVENTION. FP (r2.costs) and x1.5 (spread and slippage x1.5 around the mid, orders rebuilt on the widened quotes). sB convention: an order whose stop is under 3 spreads of its fill bar is not taken (iterative re-simulation); trades still open at the last bar are dropped. Trades entered 2022-01-01 .. 2025-12-31 are judged; K2 and K3 are held through weekends (lab).

CRITERIA. synthesis_B's text, computed mechanically in res['verdicts']: the k1_skip criteria for K1, the new_sleeve criteria for K2 and K3, and the FP live reading (not a criterion).

RUN ONCE.
